title: SUPER Module for Detail-Sensitive and Cost-Efficient U-Net Variant Decoders
what_it_is: Plug-in decoder block for U-Net-like decoders: the skip feature is split by a Haar DWT, the deeper feature is injected in the LL band, and a learned bounded mask suppresses sub-bands before the inverse DWT, so the block falls back to exact reconstruction of the skip. Full text read.
why_it_could_help_us: Built and tested for thin cracks: on CrackVision12K the 0-2 px crack IoU rose 0.356 -> 0.451 (CTS 0.872 -> 0.916) when SUPER replaced the FACS-Net decoder blocks, beating FADE (0.397) and CARAFE (0.373) in the same host; replaces only decoder blocks, so it drops into our U-Net++ decoder over the HRNet-W18 encoder.
risk_or_reason_against: Single dataset, binary crack task, 256 px, one host network; no seeds/CI reported in the table; arXiv only; our 2 px annotator noise may cap the gain on relF1@2.

title: Frequency-aware crack segmentation network (FACS-net) and crack topology loss (CT-loss) for thin cracks
new_or_pid: NEW (named in D09 text, abstract not retrieved then; no MASTER row)
what_it_is: Hybrid ResNet-50 + MiT encoder behind a stride-1 CNN head whose full-resolution features skip to the decoder; decoder fuses stages with CBAM and an FFT low/high-band split module (FPCM); loss = BCE + edge-aware + soft crack-topology term. Full text read.
why_it_could_help_us: Width-stratified evaluation: on cracks <=2 px DeepLabV3+ and Hybrid-Segmentor miss most cracks while FACS-Net keeps them (abstract: +0.306 IoU and +0.360 CTS over Hybrid-Segmentor on thin cracks); the two transferable parts for us are the full-resolution stem skip and an FFT high-band refinement at the last decoder stage of U-Net++.
risk_or_reason_against: Authors state the architecture alone does not generalise under domain shift (nnU-Net pre-trained on many sets was best on OmniCrack30K), which is our E1 problem; baselines are weak (DeepLabV3+, FCN); 256 px binary.
code_available: yes (paper says code released; repo not opened)

title: FADE: A Task-Agnostic Upsampling Operator for Encoder-Decoder Architectures
what_it_is: Upsampling operator whose kernels are generated from both the decoder feature and the high-res encoder skip, with a gate that passes encoder detail where needed; plug-in replacement for bilinear/transposed upsampling. Abstract plus results quoted in DySample and SUPER.
why_it_could_help_us: Guided upsamplers improve boundaries, not interiors (DySample paper, ADE20K SegFormer-B1: bIoU 27.80 bilinear -> 31.68 FADE); as host upsampler in FACS-Net, 0-2 px crack IoU 0.356 -> 0.397. Config-level swap of the U-Net++ upsampling steps; cheapest test of the decoder-detail hypothesis.
risk_or_reason_against: Thesis found no decoder effect (U-Net vs U-Net++), so gains may be small; gain reported on mIoU/bIoU, not tolerant line metrics.

title: Investigating Shift Equivalence of Convolutional Neural Networks in Industrial Defect Segmentation (CAPS)
what_it_is: Replaces U-Net down/upsampling with component-attention polyphase layers (all polyphase components fused by attention) plus an adaptive window for border effects. Experiments, comparison and ablation read.
why_it_could_help_us: On micro surface defects (MSD) a plain U-Net went 69.8 -> 78.2 mIoU and recall 83.1 -> 93.0 with CAPS, ahead of BlurPool, APS, LPS; outputs barely change under 1-px shifts. Recall is our weak point, and D4 TTA averages over transforms that a shift-equivariant net would already agree on.
risk_or_reason_against: Tested on small custom U-Net trained from scratch, not a pretrained HRNet; replacing strided convs breaks pretrained weights; mIoU on binary defects, not thin cracks specifically.

title: SAPA: Similarity-Aware Point Affiliation for Feature Upsampling
what_it_is: Upsampling kernels from similarity between each encoder point and the local decoder neighbourhood, encouraging smooth interiors and sharp boundaries. Abstract only (plus DySample table).
why_it_could_help_us: Second guided upsampler to screen next to FADE (SegFormer-B1 ADE20K bIoU 30.96 vs 27.80 bilinear in the DySample table); same slot in our decoder.
risk_or_reason_against: Same as FADE; no thin-structure evidence found.

title: Spatial Frequency Modulation for Semantic Segmentation (SFM)
what_it_is: Adaptive resampling before each downsampling densifies high-frequency areas, and a multi-scale adaptive upsampler demodulates them back. Intro, SOTA comparison and ablation read.
why_it_could_help_us: Beats blur pooling on Cityscapes (UPerNet-R50 78.1 -> 79.5 vs Blur 78.8); +3.3 mIoU on PSPNet only when both halves used; directly targets detail lost at strided convs, our resolution finding.
risk_or_reason_against: Needs both modules (ARS alone -0.5 mIoU); touches every downsampling layer of HRNet; mIoU-only evidence.

title: Frequency-Aware Feature Fusion for Dense Image Prediction (FreqFusion)
what_it_is: Adaptive low-pass on upsampled coarse features plus high-pass on skip features during fusion. Abstract only (this sweep).
why_it_could_help_us: Decoder-side fusion fix compatible with U-Net++; same group as SFM.
risk_or_reason_against: No thin-line evidence; already ranked RUN_AFTER_GATE in MASTER.

title: Making Convolutional Networks Shift-Invariant Again (BlurPool)
what_it_is: Low-pass blur before every strided downsampling to cut aliasing. Abstract only; its effect on defect segmentation is measured in the CAPS paper.
why_it_could_help_us: In CAPS's controlled U-Net test on micro surface defects, BlurPool raised mIoU 69.8 -> 73.2 and cut shift-induced output variation ~4x; antialiased ResNet weights exist, HRNet would need the blur inserted into its strided convs.
risk_or_reason_against: Blur also removes high frequencies (SFM argues it loses detail); recall fell 83.1 -> 80.2 in CAPS table.

title: HACNet V2: Rethinking the full-resolution architecture for pixel-level crack detection
what_it_is: Dual-branch net that keeps a full-resolution branch next to a high-resolution branch, with hybrid atrous pyramid attention and a crack-aware attention module; 0.52 M parameters, 47 FPS at 480 px. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Explicit full-resolution path (no stride) aimed at measurement-grade crack precision; cheap enough to train 5 folds x 5 seeds, and structurally different from HRNet-W18+U-Net++ (ensemble diversity).
risk_or_reason_against: Abstract only; tiny model trained from scratch may lack context for inactive/mIoU-R13; benchmarks BCL and CHCrack5K only.

title: U-HRNet: Delving into Improving Semantic Representation of High Resolution Network for Dense Prediction
what_it_is: HRNet variant that adds stages after the lowest-resolution map and drops the rule that every resolution runs in parallel, moving compute to low resolution at almost equal cost. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Drop-in replacement for the HRNet-W18 encoder (same interface) that keeps the high-res stream but adds semantics, which is what unseen-module recall and inactive may need.
risk_or_reason_against: Gains reported on Cityscapes/ADE-style benchmarks, not thin structures; PaddlePaddle weights need porting to PyTorch.

title: A Controlled Benchmark of Visual State-Space Backbones with Domain-Shift and Boundary Analysis for Remote-Sensing Segmentation
what_it_is: Swaps only the encoder (VMamba, MambaVision, Spatial-Mamba, CNN and transformer refs) under one U-Net decoder on LoveDA/Potsdam, with cross-domain and 2-px boundary/interior analysis. Full text (protocol, results, diagnostics) read.
why_it_could_help_us: Boundary mIoU (~28-29) stays ~30 points below interior for every strong encoder, and cross-domain loss concentrates on boundary pixels; within-family scaling adds little. Supports spending effort on decoder/detail and data diversity rather than another encoder swap for E1 recall.
risk_or_reason_against: Remote-sensing regions, not lines; CNN reference was weak (DeepLabv3 encoder); IGARSS short paper.

title: Rethinking Efficient Crack Segmentation with Task-Aligned Structural-Directional Modeling (RIFT)
what_it_is: Small net (0.47-1.69 M params) of blocks that combine a depthwise 3x3 local branch, horizontal/vertical 1xk and kx1 depthwise strips and a dilated branch, gated by local evidence. Method, main results and cross-dataset transfer read.
why_it_could_help_us: Best average cross-dataset transfer (train on one crack set, test on the other three): 77.0 mIoU vs SCSegamba 74.6 and MixerCSeg 71.0; best clDice/skeleton F1. The strip-conv block is a cheap decoder add-on for our long, axis-biased cracks and a diverse ensemble member for unseen-module recall.
risk_or_reason_against: Baselines are other light crack nets, not U-Net++/HRNet; binary; 3 seeds; MASTER note: its own ablation puts local-only blocks within 0.5 mIoU of full RIFT-B, so the directional part is small.

title: Learning to Upsample by Learning to Sample (DySample)
what_it_is: Dynamic upsampler that predicts sampling offsets and uses grid_sample; no custom CUDA, ~50K params. Full text (method, segmentation results) read.
why_it_could_help_us: Cheap drop-in, but its own ADE20K table shows it raises mIoU mainly in interiors (bIoU 29.12 vs FADE 31.68), so for 1-2 px cracks prefer FADE/SAPA; keep only as a control arm.
risk_or_reason_against: Authors say gains are mostly interior regions; unguided (no high-res skip), which is the wrong bias for thin lines.

title: A Refreshed Similarity-Based Upsampler for Direct High-Ratio Feature Upsampling (ReSFU)
what_it_is: Similarity-based upsampler that can upsample directly by large ratios. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Could lift stride-4/8 logits or features straight to full resolution in one step (useful for any ViT/stride-4 arm).

title: Learning Implicit Feature Alignment Function for Semantic Segmentation (IFA)
what_it_is: Implicit neural function that queries multi-level features at continuous coordinates to produce full-resolution predictions instead of bilinear upsampling. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: A way to predict at full resolution from stride-4 features (relevant to any SegFormer/ViT arm whose head stops at 1/4).
risk_or_reason_against: Evidence is on Cityscapes/ADE20K mIoU; no thin-line results.

title: SFNet: Faster and Accurate Semantic Segmentation via Semantic Flow
what_it_is: Learns flow fields to align low-res semantic features to high-res ones before fusion in an FPN. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Misaligned upsampled features blur thin lines; flow alignment in skip fusion is a decoder-only change.
code_available: yes (stated in paper family; not verified)

title: When Semantic Segmentation Meets Frequency Aliasing
what_it_is: Shows hard pixels correlate with aliasing; proposes de-aliasing filter and frequency mixing modules. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Diagnostic for whether our missed cracks sit where strided convs alias.

title: Frequency-Dynamic Attention Modulation for Dense Prediction (FDAM)
what_it_is: Adds a high-pass path by inverting the attention matrix and re-weights frequency bands, to stop ViT layers acting as stacked low-pass filters; gains on SegFormer, DeiT, MaskDINO. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Only useful for the ViT/SegFormer/DINO arms (our ViTs lose thin cracks); plug-in to attention blocks.
risk_or_reason_against: Not useful for the HRNet CNN winner; no thin-line evidence.

title: Learnable Polyphase Sampling for Shift Invariant and Equivariant Convolutional Networks (LPS)
what_it_is: Learnable down/upsampling pair choosing polyphase components, giving truly shift-equivariant segmentation nets. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Comparison arm for CAPS (in CAPS table LPS: mIoU 72.0, recall 88.0 vs baseline 83.1).

title: FRD-Net: a full-resolution dilated convolution network for retinal vessel segmentation
what_it_is: Backbone keeps full image resolution throughout and grows context with multi-rate dilated convolutions; fusion module re-injects the original image. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Thin low-contrast vessels are our closest analogue; a no-downsampling net is a direct test of 'resolution matters' beyond HRNet's 1/4 top stream.
risk_or_reason_against: Abstract only; memory heavy at 512 px x 24 classes; dilated nets can grid.

title: U-shaped high-resolution network for semantic segmentation of concrete cracks (Crack-UHRNet)
what_it_is: U-HRNet backbone + OCR context head for concrete cracks, plus a crack quantification workflow. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Applied evidence that U-HRNet+OCR works on cracks; supports testing U-HRNet in place of HRNet-W18.

title: Real-time high-resolution neural network with semantic guidance for crack segmentation (HrSegNet)
what_it_is: Keeps a high-resolution path throughout and adds semantic guidance from a low-res path. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Already in MASTER; included because it is the main crack-specific HRNet-like design.

title: HRFormer: High-Resolution Transformer for Dense Prediction
what_it_is: HRNet layout with local-window transformer blocks in every stream. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Keeps HRNet's 1/4 stream but adds attention; a natural 'HRNet but transformer' encoder swap.
risk_or_reason_against: Window attention at 1/4 is costly; no thin-line evidence; mmseg weights only for some sizes.

title: Multi-Scale High-Resolution Vision Transformer for Semantic Segmentation (HRViT)
what_it_is: Multi-branch high-resolution ViT with heterogeneous branches; ADE20K 50.20, Cityscapes 83.16 with fewer params/FLOPs than MiT/CSWin. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Strongest HR-transformer encoder found; a candidate to beat HRNet-W18 in a matched-cost encoder swap.
risk_or_reason_against: ImageNet weights only from official repo; no thin-line evidence.

title: PIDNet: A Real-time Semantic Segmentation Network Inspired by PID Controllers
what_it_is: Three branches (detail, context, boundary); the boundary branch's attention decides where detail vs context features dominate the fusion; Cityscapes 78.6 at 93 FPS. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: The boundary-attention fusion idea maps to cracks (boundary-like); also a cheap structurally different ensemble member.
risk_or_reason_against: Detail branch runs at 1/8, coarser than HRNet's 1/4, so likely worse on 1-2 px lines as a whole net; borrow only the boundary-guided fusion.

title: Rethinking BiSeNet For Real-time Semantic Segmentation (STDC)
what_it_is: Drops BiSeNet's spatial path; instead supervises a low-level stage with a Laplacian detail map (detail guidance) at training only. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: The training-only detail-guidance head (binary edge/detail target on an early stage) is a zero-inference-cost add-on to our HRNet high-res stream.
risk_or_reason_against: Natural-scene evidence; similar to boundary aux losses already tried in spirit (skeleton recall).

title: SCTNet: Single-Branch CNN with Transformer Semantic Information for Real-Time Segmentation
what_it_is: Single-branch CNN that learns transformer semantics via a training-only transformer branch and alignment. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Pattern for getting ViT context into our CNN without ViT at inference (unseen-module recall).

title: Gated-SCNN: Gated Shape CNNs for Semantic Segmentation
what_it_is: Separate shape stream at high resolution gated by the regular stream, supervised with boundaries; strongest gains on thin/small classes (poles, signs) in Cityscapes. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: A shape stream fed from the HRNet stride-2/4 features, supervised with crack edges, is a head-only change.
risk_or_reason_against: Already PARKED in MASTER (P392 under arXiv id).

title: SegMAN: Omni-scale Context Modeling with State Space Models and Local Attention for Semantic Segmentation
what_it_is: Hybrid encoder (sliding local attention + dynamic SSM) and an SSM-based multi-scale decoder; Cityscapes 83.8 (+2.1 over SegFormer-B3 at half the GFLOPs), ADE20K 52.6. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Most recent strong general segmenter that explicitly claims fine local detail plus global context; candidate encoder for the 'context for unseen modules' gap.
risk_or_reason_against: Stride-4 output; no thin-line evidence; Mamba kernels add infra risk.

title: UniRepLKNet: A Universal Perception Large-Kernel ConvNet
what_it_is: Large-kernel ConvNet design rules (dilated reparam small kernels), strong on ImageNet/ADE20K. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Large kernels give context to link fragmented cracks while staying convolutional (good on small data).
risk_or_reason_against: Stride-4 stem like ResNet; no thin-line evidence.

title: VMamba: Visual State Space Model
what_it_is: 2D selective-scan state-space backbone. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: In the controlled RS benchmark (below), VMamba-T beat the CNN reference by +12 mIoU on LoveDA under a fixed U-Net decoder; candidate encoder swap.
risk_or_reason_against: Benchmark's CNN reference was a DeepLabv3 encoder, not HRNet; boundary mIoU stayed ~29.

title: MambaVision: A Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Vision Backbone
what_it_is: Hierarchical hybrid with conv early stages and Mamba+attention late stages. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Conv early stages keep detail; in the RS benchmark MambaVision-T matched VMamba at higher FPS.

title: What Survives Label Downsampling? Exact Region Survival for Coarse Segmentation Targets (MatchDown)
what_it_is: Builds coarse training targets by min-cost matching of regions to grid cells so no region that could survive is dropped; majority pooling/strided sampling lose 4-5x more regions. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: If any of our heads is supervised below full resolution (deep supervision, HRNet aux, ViT stride-4 heads), 1-2 px cracks vanish from the target; MatchDown is a one-off preprocessing fix.
risk_or_reason_against: Only matters for coarse-stride supervision; our U-Net++ head is full-res.

title: CARAFE: Content-Aware ReAssembly of FEatures
what_it_is: Content-aware reassembly kernels predicted from the low-res feature. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Reference upsampler; in the SUPER paper it gave 0-2 px crack IoU 0.373 vs 0.356 baseline at 2.6x decoder MACs, below FADE and SUPER.
risk_or_reason_against: Unguided; heavy; superseded by FADE/SAPA for detail.

title: CARAFE++: Unified Content-Aware ReAssembly of FEatures
what_it_is: Extends CARAFE to content-aware downsampling as well. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Only relevant if we test content-aware downsampling in the encoder; lower priority than anti-aliased/polyphase downsampling.

title: Lighten CARAFE: Dynamic Lightweight Upsampling with Guided Reassemble Kernels
what_it_is: Lighter guided CARAFE variant. Title and index metadata only (no abstract returned).
why_it_could_help_us: Possible cheap guided upsampler alternative; nothing specific to thin lines.
risk_or_reason_against: Not read; no evidence on thin structures.

title: LDA-AQU: Adaptive Query-guided Upsampling via Local Deformable Attention
what_it_is: Query-guided upsampler with local deformable attention. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Another guided upsampler to keep in reserve if FADE/SAPA show a signal.

title: A3-FPN: Asymptotic content-aware pyramid attention network for dense visual prediction
what_it_is: Content-aware pyramid attention FPN. Title only (no abstract returned).
why_it_could_help_us: Possible decoder alternative; unverified.

title: Truly shift-invariant convolutional neural networks (APS)
what_it_is: Adaptive polyphase sampling picks the max-norm polyphase component. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Baseline for the shift-equivariance arm; CAPS table: APS did not raise mIoU on defects.
risk_or_reason_against: No segmentation gain in CAPS test.

title: Improving Shift Invariance in CNNs with Translation Invariant Polyphase Sampling
what_it_is: Translation-invariant polyphase sampling for CNN pooling. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Newer alternative in the same arm as CAPS/LPS.

title: Alias-Free Convnets: Fractional Shift Invariance via Polynomial Activations
what_it_is: Removes aliasing from both downsampling and non-linearities using polynomial activations. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Theory reference for the anti-aliasing arm.

title: Making Vision Transformers Truly Shift-Equivariant
what_it_is: Adaptive polyphase patch embedding and tokenisation for ViTs. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Only for ViT arms; relevant to 16-px token grids on 1-2 px lines.
risk_or_reason_against: ViT arms are not our leading line.

title: Toward better semantic segmentation by retaining spectral information using matched wavelet pooling
what_it_is: Matched wavelet pooling replaces strided/avg/max pooling to keep spectral information. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Another lossless-downsampling option next to HWD (already in MASTER).

title: Enhanced damage segmentation in RC components using pyramid Haar wavelet downsampling and attention U-net
what_it_is: U-Net with pyramid Haar wavelet downsampling for concrete damage. Title only.
why_it_could_help_us: Applied evidence that HWD-style downsampling is used for cracks.

title: Full-Resolution Residual Networks for Semantic Segmentation in Street Scenes (FRRN)
what_it_is: Residual stream at full image resolution plus a pooling stream for context, coupled at every stage. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Origin of the full-res-stream idea (HACNet/FRD-Net follow it); reference for an add-on full-res stream beside HRNet.

title: ETAFHrNet: A Transformer-Based Multi-Scale Network for Asymmetric Pavement Crack Segmentation
what_it_is: HRNet-style multi-scale network with transformer attention for pavement cracks. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Applied HRNet-hybrid crack evidence; low priority.

title: Lite-HRNet: A Lightweight High-Resolution Network
what_it_is: HRNet with shuffle blocks and conditional channel weighting; designed for pose. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Cheaper HR encoder for ensembles; little reason to expect better thin-line accuracy than W18.

title: HR-NAS: Searching Efficient High-Resolution Neural Architectures with Lightweight Transformers
what_it_is: NAS over high-resolution architectures with light transformers. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Reference only.

what_it_is: Two parallel branches (high-res 1/8 and low-res) with bilateral fusion and a deep aggregation pyramid. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Reference two-branch design; same 1/8 limit as PIDNet.

what_it_is: Real-time net avoiding multi-path blocks via reparameterisation. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Low relevance; reference for real-time SOTA.

what_it_is: Real-time two-resolution transformer with GPU-friendly attention. Abstract only.

what_it_is: Predict-refine net with hybrid boundary-aware loss for fine structures. Abstract only.

what_it_is: Two-stream net jointly predicting semantics and boundaries with an active fusion decoder. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Joint boundary head as auxiliary for crack edges.

what_it_is: PointRend-style refinement for HR crack images. Abstract only.

what_it_is: Transformer + point-rendering refinement for HR crack images. Abstract (truncated) only.

what_it_is: Large ConvNet built on DCNv3. Abstract only.

what_it_is: ConvNeXt with global response norm, pretrained by fully convolutional MAE. Abstract only.

what_it_is: Argues for topology-aware checkpoint/model selection for ConvNeXt crack segmenters. Title only (no abstract).

what_it_is: ConvNeXt-T encoder + Mamba decoder with a boundary-supervised local detail prior and an entropy-gated 'reload' that restores detail diluted by state-space propagation; ADE20K 47.9, Cityscapes 83.2. Abstract only.

what_it_is: Morphology-aware Mamba scanning in a conv U-Net for retinal vessels. Abstract (truncated) only.

what_it_is: Lightweight Mamba-attention net for thin low-contrast vessels. Title only.

what_it_is: Crack-specific mixer of CNN, attention and Mamba paths. Already in MASTER.
why_it_could_help_us: In RIFT's cross-dataset table MixerCSeg averaged 71.0 mIoU vs RIFT-T 77.0.

title: SCSegamba: Lightweight Structure-Aware Vision Mamba for Crack Segmentation in Structures
what_it_is: Structure-aware scanning Mamba crack segmenter. Already in MASTER.
why_it_could_help_us: In RIFT's transfer table SCSegamba averaged 74.6 vs RIFT-T 77.0.

title: A crack detection and quantification framework for high-resolution images using Mamba and unmanned devices
what_it_is: Mamba-based segmentation for slender cracks in HR images. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Applied evidence only.

title: MorFormer: Morphology-Aware Transformer for Generalized Pavement Crack Segmentation
what_it_is: Morphology-aware transformer claimed to generalise across pavement crack sets. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Generalisation claim relates to unseen-module recall; worth an abstract check by a crack scout.

title: Vision Transformers for Dense Prediction (DPT)
what_it_is: Reassembles ViT tokens from several layers into an image-like pyramid and fuses them convolutionally. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Standard way to put a ViT/DINO encoder under a conv decoder; needed only for ViT arms.

title: EfficientViT: Multi-Scale Linear Attention for High-Resolution Dense Prediction
what_it_is: Linear attention with multi-scale tokens for high-resolution dense prediction. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Lets attention run on larger inputs (1024 px) cheaply; only if a ViT arm is revived.

title: ViT-CoMer: Vision Transformer with Convolutional Multi-scale Feature Interaction for Dense Predictions
what_it_is: Conv multi-scale branch fused bidirectionally with a plain ViT. Already in MASTER.
why_it_could_help_us: Same slot as ViT-Adapter for a DINO arm.

title: Vision Transformer Adapter for Dense Predictions
what_it_is: Spatial-prior conv branch injected into a plain ViT. Already in MASTER.
why_it_could_help_us: Same as ViT-CoMer.

title: Revisiting Efficient Semantic Segmentation: Learning Offsets for Better Spatial and Class Feature Alignment
what_it_is: Learns offsets to align spatial and class features in efficient segmenters. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Decoder alignment idea similar to SFNet.

title: A High-Resolution Network with Strip Attention for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
what_it_is: HRNet with strip attention for retinal vessels. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Strip attention inside our HRNet streams fits long thin lines; applied evidence only.

title: HRD-Net: High resolution segmentation network with adaptive learning ability of retinal vessel features
what_it_is: High-resolution vessel segmentation network. Title only.
why_it_could_help_us: Applied HR evidence on thin vessels.

title: Full-scale representation guided network for retinal vessel segmentation (FSG-Net)
what_it_is: Full-scale feature representation module with guided convolution in a U-Net for vessels. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Full-scale skips for thin vessels; similar to UNet 3+ (in MASTER).

title: SegFix: Model-Agnostic Boundary Refinement for Segmentation
what_it_is: Replaces boundary pixel labels by interior pixel labels via predicted offsets. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Already in MASTER; for 1-2 px cracks there is no 'interior', so likely harmful.

title: Vision Mamba: Efficient Visual Representation Learning with Bidirectional State Space Model (Vim)
what_it_is: Plain bidirectional Mamba with 16-px patches. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Low: plain patch-16 token grid has the same 1-2 px problem as ViTs.

title: Mamba-Reg: Vision Mamba Also Needs Registers
what_it_is: Shows high-norm artefact tokens in Vision Mamba feature maps and fixes them with registers. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Relevant only if a plain Mamba is used as dense encoder.

title: SGL-Mamba: Structure-Aware Global-Local Mamba for Crack Segmentation
what_it_is: Global-local structure-aware Mamba crack segmenter. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Applied only.

title: Topology-aware dual-branch network via lightweight Mamba for crack segmentation and quantification
what_it_is: Dual-branch CNN/Mamba crack net with topology awareness. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Applied only.

title: Vision-LSTM: xLSTM as Generic Vision Backbone
what_it_is: Plain xLSTM-based vision backbone (ViL). Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Low: plain patch backbone like ViT.

title: xLSTM-UNet can be an Effective Backbone for 2D & 3D Biomedical Image Segmentation Better than its Mamba Counterparts
what_it_is: Replaces Mamba in U-Mamba with xLSTM. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Reference for the sequence-model U-Net family.
risk_or_reason_against: nnU-Net-revisited style caveats on weak baselines.

title: Are Vision-xLSTM-embedded U-Nets better at segmenting medical images?
what_it_is: Evaluation of xLSTM blocks inside U-Nets. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Evidence on whether xLSTM adds anything; reference.

title: U-RWKV: Lightweight Medical Image Segmentation with Direction-Adaptive RWKV
what_it_is: Lightweight RWKV U-Net with direction-adaptive scanning. Title/metadata only.
why_it_could_help_us: Reference for RWKV family (RWKV-UNet already in MASTER).

title: CSwinUKAN: An enhanced U-Net architecture with swin-transformer and Kolmogorov-Arnold network modification for tunnel lining cracks segmentation
what_it_is: Swin + KAN modified U-Net for tunnel-lining cracks. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Only KAN paper on cracks found; low.

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Convolutions: Design Principles and Empirical Studies
what_it_is: Empirical study of KAN convolutions in vision. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Reference for KAN layers; no reason to expect thin-line gains.

title: CrackScopeNet: A Lightweight Neural Network for Rapid Crack Detection on Resource-Constrained Drone Platforms
what_it_is: Lightweight crack segmenter with multi-scale strip context. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Applied only.

title: What Does the Encoder Actually Decide? A Controlled Comparison of Vision Backbones on Joint Tree Segmentation and Stereo Depth
what_it_is: Swaps only the encoder at ~25 M params on thin vegetation segmentation from scratch; abstract claims conv/hybrid encoders beat transformers and boundary F1 exposes collapsed models. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Would support keeping a CNN/hybrid encoder, but the indexed abstract still contains template placeholders ([N], [BestEncoder]), so no numbers can be used.
risk_or_reason_against: Abstract has unfilled placeholders: treat as unreliable until a clean version exists.

title: SegViT: Semantic Segmentation with Plain Vision Transformers
what_it_is: Attention-to-mask decoder for plain ViTs. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Low: 1/16 token grid.

title: SegViT v2: Exploring Efficient and Continual Semantic Segmentation with Plain Vision Transformers
what_it_is: Efficient SegViT variant. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Low.

title: Vision Transformers: From Semantic Segmentation to Dense Prediction (SETR journal)
what_it_is: Journal extension of SETR with hierarchical local-global ViT. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Reference.

title: FastViT: A Fast Hybrid Vision Transformer using Structural Reparameterization
what_it_is: Reparameterised hybrid conv/attention backbone. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Reference only.

title: EVA: Exploring the Limits of Masked Visual Representation Learning at Scale
what_it_is: Billion-scale MIM-pretrained ViT with strong ADE20K transfer. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Low: ViT arms already underperform on 1-2 px lines.

title: OneFormer: One Transformer to Rule Universal Image Segmentation
what_it_is: Task-conditioned universal mask transformer. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Mask classifiers covered by D23; low for thin cracks.

title: MPViT: Multi-Path Vision Transformer for Dense Prediction
what_it_is: Multi-path patch embeddings at several scales in parallel. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Reference only.

title: Head-Free Lightweight Semantic Segmentation with Linear Transformer (AFFormer)
what_it_is: Head-free lightweight segmenter using frequency-based linear attention. Abstract (truncated) only.
why_it_could_help_us: Reference only.

title: High-Resolution Swin Transformer for Automatic Medical Image Segmentation (HRSTNet)
what_it_is: HRNet-style parallel streams built from Swin blocks. Abstract only.
why_it_could_help_us: Reference for HR transformer in medical.
